long_biography.plain_text:
Leaving Deloitte Haskins & Sells to establish Heller Capital turned Andrew M. Heller from management consultant into principal investor. The private company backed young businesses, acquisitions and property ventures, giving him scope to combine capital allocation with active company building. One medical-device manufacturer expanded eightfold in three years, and he also co-founded an early online-mortgage originator.

Born in Chicago, Heller first encountered commerce while working for his father’s electronics distribution company in Cleveland. He studied at Wesleyan University and completed an MBA at Wharton before entering consulting. He later chaired Putnam Precision Products, a New York contract manufacturer serving medical, aerospace, defence and industrial customers. Alongside those operating and investment roles, he maintained a long record of educational and cultural philanthropy.
